title: 初級沉澱池設計
summary: 本課以沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支為主線，從懸浮固體進流、沉降速度與池深、表面溢流率、有效停留與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance through ten connected units, beginning with influent suspended-solids loading, settling velocity and depth, surface overflow rate, effective residence and bypass. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 懸浮固體進流：機制與觀察

steps.instruction: 初沉池去除可沉固體，負荷需以 TSS、沉降性與流量共同界定。

quiz.explanation: 槽內堆積被誤當穩定去除。 在離線工作台先選取「固體去向驗證」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulation is mistaken for steady removal. In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solids-destination verification. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

workedExample.text: 原創教學假設：Q=2000 m³/d；C=180 mg/L。模型 L=QC/1000，代入得到 360 kg/d。適用邊界：穩定流量與流量加權濃度；瞬時樣本不代表整日。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=2000 m³/d; C=180 mg/L. Model L=QC/1000 gives 360 kg/d. Applicability: Steady flow and flow-weighted concentration; a grab sample does not represent a day.
